title: Governments Draft Shared Rules for Frontier AI Models
summary: A joint framework would set testing and disclosure requirements.

body.text: Long term, the impact will depend on adoption by the wider industry.
Supporters point to similar efforts abroad that delivered results within a few years.
We are only at the beginning of what this makes possible.
The team behind the effort credits a small group of volunteers who worked through the summer.
Analysts say the move could reshape how teams plan their next two years of work.

author.name: Tom Okafor
author.bio: Developer tools and open source reporter.
